anomalies.description: A dark-colored car loses control, veers off the road, and collides with a tree on the sidewalk, producing smoke/dust upon impact.

Immediately after the car impacts the tree, a large cloud of dust/debris erupts violently from the point of impact, consistent with a secondary explosion or structural failure (e.g., fuel tank rupture or airbag deployment combined with debris). The rapid expansion and opacity suggest a sudden energy release beyond typical crash debris.

A vehicle (likely a motorcycle or scooter) collides with a tree in a parking lot, generating a large dust/debris cloud that obscures the scene; the vehicle appears to be thrown or slide sideways upon impact and remains obscured afterward.
A white semi-truck with a trailer loses control, jackknifes, and overturns onto its side on the right shoulder of a two-lane road, coming to rest blocking part of the roadway.
